description: This header file defines the API interface for TR-069 device IP diagnostics upload functionalities, including setting diagnostic parameters like DiagnosticsState, Interface, UploadURL, DSCP, EthernetPriority, and TestFileLength. It provides function prototypes for configuring upload diagnostics on CPE devices in TR-069 management scenarios.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_DiagnosticsState
methods.description: Sets the DiagnosticsState parameter to initiate, complete, or report errors for diagnostics tests.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_Interface
methods.description: Configures the network interface for performing the diagnostics test.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_UploadURL
methods.description: Sets the URL (HTTP or FTP) where the upload diagnostics should send data.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_DSCP
methods.description: Configures the DSCP marking for packets transmitted during the test.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_EthernetPriority
methods.description: Sets the Ethernet priority code for transmitted packets.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_TestFileLength
methods.description: Configures the size of the file to upload during diagnostics.
